let's check, the first question, what film type is it?As we can see in the first sentence, it is a cartoon.And the writer thinks it is a brilliant cartoon.The word brilliant here means very good, excellent.From the word brilliant, it used here.We can tell that the writer was definitely a big fan of this film.The writer clearly expressed how he liked this film at the beginning part of the film review.And the main characters are two robots, Warly and Eva.And the story is set in the future on the earth.Here we can find phrases like, in the future, leave the earth, on the earth, and return to the earth.Let's read paragraphs 1 and 2, the description of the film again, and tell how the writer introduced the film in details.Let's find out how the writer introduced the film to the readers.Firstly, the writer introduced the story briefly, according to the change of time.One day, when they leave, years later, and as her spaceship takes off.From the description of the film, readers can read the conflict and the development of the plot.You see, at the very beginning, Worley is the only living thing left on the earth, except a small bug.But something has totally changed when Eva arrives.One is funny and a little bit clumsy, the other is fast and smart.Surprisingly, in the end, these two main characters have a romantic adventure.But they are too different, and they even don't speak the same language.So how would the romantic adventure be like?It really hooks readers with such an attractive film plot.But what kind of romantic adventure will it be?Go and find it yourself.That's what the writer really wanted you to do.Now, let's move on.Please read paragraphs 3 and 4 and answer these two questions.What does the writer think of the film?Why does he or she think so?Please take out your worksheet and finish task 2.In paragraph 3, the writer gives three reasons to explain why this film is enjoyable and moving.And supporting details that help make the writer's opinions convincing can also be found in this paragraph.The funny characters and the special effect used in the film make the film enjoyable.Well, the friendship between Worley and Eva can be moving.Besides the three things the writer mentioned in the third paragraph.Did he or she give any other reasons to tell the readers why he or she liked this film?In paragraph 4, the writer wrote,The film also makes you think it has a powerful message about the environment.So the writer wanted to let readers know.Besides its funny characters, its plot, or its special effect, the film also makes the viewers reflect on their own behaviors.Surely, the writer wanted to recommend the film to the readers.After reading the film review, do you want to see this film?What kind of audience will be interested in this film?Families, right?Because it was the hit family film of the year.Usually we use hit as a verb, but here it is a noun, meaning a very popular song, a film or a play, etc.What made it a hit family film?Can you guess?I think the sweet and funny cartoon characters are always children's favorite.And the film plot is full of imagination.For parents, the superb visual design and animation can get them involved.Besides, it delivers an important message about environmental protection to all the people going into the cinema.These are my possible answers.You may have your own ideas.Does a film review strictly stick to a format?Actually, some are long and detailed.Others are short and brief.Does a film review always give positive opinions?Let's take a quick look at this film review.What does this author think about this film?Actually, this film review doesn't give a recommendation.It even says this film is the worst of all the Spider-Man movies.Here, we can learn that film reviews are not always positive.Film reviews vary in length or opinions.Today, we have learned a film review about Wally.After reading, would you like to see Wally with your own eyes?If your answer is yes, tell me why.If no, why not?Who would like to share your idea?Jessica?Yes, I am really interested in this film.Because I like watching cartoons, especially funny ones.I guess this is a film with full of laughter and fun.Another reason is the topic is about environment.It can call on more people to be aware of the importance of environment.Well done, Jessica.Some people go to see a movie because of its funny plot.And they can laugh and relax themselves.How about you, Sam?No, I don't like science fiction films.The plot isn't out of expectation.I bet there will be a happy ending like most romantic stories.Although Wally was the hit family film of the year and it was very popular,I will not follow the crowd.Terrific.Never follow the crowd, but follow your heart.Here is today's homework.I hope you have had a good time with me.See you next time.
